request:
Source ticket: MAG-15 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-15/battery-consumed-graph

RM28 tier 1. Create the charge_gaps table (days whose battery math does not add up because a charge record is missing or incomplete) plus its GapWriter write port, and add SuperchargerSessionsByVehicleBetween to the SuperchargerReader port. Roadmap decisions D3, D7, D7a, D7b, D9, D12 bind this change.

decisions.decision: DATABASE DESIGN GATE PASSED. The user reviewed and approved the charge_gaps schema, its rationale and its index plan, with one change: the date column is renamed to gap_date.
decisions.why: A bare `date` would be the only non-descriptive date column in the schema (cf. charged_on, captured_date, charge_start_date_time) and is a Postgres col_name_keyword. The Go domain field stays ChargeGap.Date to avoid stuttering.

decisions.decision: idx_charge_gaps_account (account_id, gap_date DESC) is KEPT despite serving a notification feature that does not exist yet.
decisions.why: Leader flagged it as speculative on a table that stays tiny. The user chose to keep it rather than defer; it is cheap and the read pattern is declared in the design.

decisions.decision: Collapsed the five computed depends_on waves into two dispatches: wave 1 = T1-T6 (implementation), wave 2 = T7-T8 (DB tests + docs).
decisions.why: Every computed wave is a serial single-module chain, so five dispatches would re-read the doc pack five times for zero parallelism. Tests stay last: they cannot compile before the migration and sqlc types exist.

decisions.decision: Leader added the missing SuperchargerSessionsByVehicleBetween method to the test doubles in internal/battery and internal/gateway/handlers, as panic-on-call stubs.
decisions.why: Adding a port method broke go vet in two sibling modules. Cross-module integration is the leader’s job, not a sandboxed worker’s. Panic, not nil, so an unexpected call fails loudly.

events.note: telemetry worker produced proposal.md, design.md, specs/telemetry/spec.md, tasks.md. openspec validate --strict passes. Worker reported no contradictions found.

Leader presented schema + rationale + index plan to the user, flagging two concerns (bare `date` column name, speculative second index). User approved with the rename; index kept. See decisions G1/G2.
Wave 1 (T1-T6) dispatched to one serial telemetry worker on Sonnet. Budget at dispatch: five_hour 42%, context 32%, cost $32.15.
Wave 1 (T1-T6) complete. go build + go vet clean repo-wide after the leader fixed two cross-module fakes. gofmt noise (14 files) confirmed pre-existing on main. Suite NOT run - awaiting the user.
